title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the angular velocity of precession, omega_p.

title: Force Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the force acting on the planet, including both gravitational and repulsive components.

title: Binet's Formula Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Binet's formula correctly to relate the orbit's parameters and derive the necessary equations.

title: Small Perturbation Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up and analyze the small perturbation around the circular orbit.

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the equations.
